inputs.prompt:
How the reference pictures align with the target video — <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; <Picture 2> (from [Shot 2]) aligns with the 5.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: Photorealistic cinematic film, 35mm with natural grain, warm tungsten work lamps and a cool blue glow from the gadget, rain streaking the dark skylight, real unretouched skin with visible pores. Keep exactly the faces and costumes of the two men in <Picture 1>; their faces must stay the same people in every frame. The pirate: red patterned bandana, dark deep-set eyes, hollow cheeks, long pointed dark goatee and thin moustache, silver hoop earring, long dark dreadlocks threaded with colourful beads, weathered brown leather coat. The inventor: wild shaggy grey-white hair, brass goggles pushed up on his forehead, very wide pale-blue eyes, short dark beard and moustache, grey work shirt under a stained white lab coat. Normal real-time speed, no slow motion. The inventor (S1) has an excitable, quick, energetic male voice. The pirate (S2) has a deep, gravelly male voice with a dry, teasing edge. [Shot 1] 0-2.5 s: the over-the-shoulder medium close-up of <Picture 1>, the inventor's grey-white hair soft in the right foreground, the pirate in focus across the bench, lit blue from below; the camera drifts slowly closer. The pirate raises one eyebrow, taps the gadget's glass with a fingertip, and the pirate (S2) asks: "So... what does it do?" [Shot 2] 2.5-5 s: hard cut to the reverse angle, a close-up of the inventor from the pirate's side of the bench; this shot is the face of <Picture 2> and ends exactly as <Picture 2>. He leans toward the camera with a wicked grin, his wide eyes catching the blue glow, and the inventor (S1) whispers: "It makes your hair... louder."

overall_soundscape: Rain on the skylight and the gadget's steady hum continue under both shots; a light glassy tap when his fingertip hits the gadget, a leather creak as the pirate leans in, and the soft creak of the bench as the inventor leans over it.
